rationale: First TabDPT v1.1 claude-mode shot (context=512, n_ens=2 — minor nudge below search-space min of 1024, forced by wall-time budget) produced unprecedented W6 +102.1% ann at thr=0.0 (biggest single-window W6 ann across last 20+ claude iters) and W4 +42.8% ann alive thr=0.3 sweep, but WR collapses on W2/W7 (~22%) — the FAISS-retrieved per-row k-NN context picks high-magnitude winners AND losers, +9.87% avg_win vs -3.44% avg_loss = 2.87:1 reward/risk that needs >30% WR. Train mode should sweep temperature ∈ {0.5, 0.8, 1.2} (sharpen retrieval), normalizer ∈ {standard, quantile-normal, power} (reduce outlier influence on W2/W7), feature_reduction ∈ {pca, subsample}, and n_ensembles ∈ {2, 4} — the W6 magnitude signal at default HPs is novel for the registry and worth preserving across HP sweeps.
